key_points.text: My guest this week is Catherine Minchew, the co-founder and CEO of the Muse and co-author of the New Rules for Work.
key_points.evidence_quote: My guest this week is Catherine Minchew, the co-founder and CEO of the Muse and co-author of the New Rules for Work, the Modern Playbook for Navigating Your Career.

thesis: The conversation argues that the modern approach to careers has shifted from viewing jobs merely as a means to pay bills to seeking a personal 'fit' based on values, mission, and culture. Kathryn Minshew proposes that employers and candidates should evaluate roles using three dimensions—people, purpose, and path—rather than relying solely on salary, and she advises that companies must actively market their culture through compelling content to attract talent.
